en: The First Collection, Chapter on Virtue (Sīlavagga)
4. The Birth Story of the Wind-Deer “Indeed,
there is nothing more wretched than flavors,
nor than dwellings or social attachments;”
“Sañjaya brought the wind-deer dwelling in the forest under his control by means of flavors.
Thus ends the fourth Jātaka, the Wind-Deer Jātaka.
